whatIsIt.eli5: A learned way of making the picture twice as big.
whatIsIt.simple: A transposed convolution with kernel 2 and stride 2: each input value paints a learned 2×2 patch, doubling the size.
whatIsIt.engineer: nn.ConvTranspose2d(c, c, 2, 2, bias=True); MACs = H_in·W_in·c2·k²·c1/… (thop counts input volume × c_out × k²).

whyExists.eli5: Masks need a big, sharp picture.
whyExists.simple: Learned upsampling gives sharper prototype masks than copying.

eli5: Each dot paints a small square.
simple: Each input value is multiplied by a learned 2×2 kernel per output channel and placed in the output.
